caption: The drawing depicts a metallic-looking horse in mid-gallop positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The horse is rendered in profile, facing right, with its legs extended in a running motion. The body of the horse shows shades of dark green and brown, with some areas of lighter green suggesting the effect of patina or weathering, especially on the upper areas of the body and the tail. The mane and tail are depicted with simple, linear detail, and both appear swept back, accentuating the movement. The horse stands atop a thin, horizontal base with two vertical supports connecting the hooves to the base, suggesting the depiction of a weather vane or similar sculptural object. The edges of the horse and the base are clean and sharply defined, with no additional objects or backgrounds present.
title: Weather Vane - Horse
